name: Ghost (Isabella)
subjectPrompt: The ghost of Isabella Falinescu, nine-year-old daughter of a Barovian toymaker, in the white soft cotton formal dress she wore at her music practice. She is a mischievous, friendly spirit, floating a small way from the ground, almost transparent near her hems, arms, and feet. An expression half thoughtful and half playfully curious. One worn handmade rag doll nestled in her arms, light brown braided hair, little dark ribbon on her sleeve, painted warm off-white and cool gray-violet accents. Show her uninjured, as she appears through magic that reveals her without illness. No wounds or decay, no fear or peril. The doll is a small inanimate prop rather than a separate figure.

name: Toy Soldier
subjectPrompt: One small old-fashioned animated wooden toy soldier handmade by an eccentric Barovian inventor. A chipped painted claret-and-ink-blue uniform, brass pins in elbows and knees, tiny visible clockwork wheels under a shoulder seam, small military cap and an unsettling thin carved wooden smile. He stands upright saluting with one wooden hand and carries a tiny plain dagger-sized sword low to his side in the other. Warm wood grain and subtle scuffed edges. A simple hand-cranked polished wood control box near one boot, with a plain brass handle and a single purple glass glint, only if it fits. No other toys or background.
